notes.title: 2020 Haloween Sale!
notes.content: Hey guys! Who's excited for Halloween! I know I am, so I'm doing a Halloween sale event. From 10 am-ish October 29th to 10 am-ish November 2nd Capsule will be 90 percent off. That's right, 49 cents. If this game has been sitting on your wishlist collecting dust, maybe now is a good time to jump in and check it out! I hope you enjoy playing it as much I enjoyed making it.
